description: This file contains unit tests for the 'route_request' function in the 'litellm.proxy.route_llm_request' module. The tests use pytest and asyncio to verify the behavior of route_request with different route types, including cases with and without model parameters, and with or without a router object.

methods.name: test_route_request_dynamic_credentials(route_type)
methods.description: Tests route_request with various route types and dynamic credentials, mocking the route_request call.

methods.name: test_route_request_no_model_required()
methods.description: Tests route_request with route types that do not require the 'model' parameter, verifying correct method calls and responses.

methods.name: test_route_request_no_model_required_with_router_settings()
methods.description: Tests route_request with route types that do not require 'model', including router settings configurations.

methods.name: test_route_request_no_model_required_with_router_settings_and_no_router()
methods.description: Tests route_request when no router object is provided, mocking an external call to 'litellm.acompletion'.
